description:
Outcome: establish tools enabling the first-version journeys and emailed sign-in/digest, from brief.md First version/Constraints and owner answers.
Scope: select and document stack, relational database, hosting, email provider and durable scheduler; create minimal app, test/build/server commands and first real test; sandbox delivery feasibility and provider idempotency constraints. Excludes: feature implementation, purchases, production deployment and real-recipient mail.
Acceptance: reproducible bootstrap, collected passing test, working documented commands, sandbox email feasibility and durable scheduling strategy; enable recipe stages only when commands and tests are established.
Behaviour: actionable configuration errors; no secrets in repository/logs and no real emails in tests.
Verification: clean bootstrap/test/build and sandbox checks during implementation. Prerequisites: none. Assumptions: owner delegated technology selection; credentials required before live delivery.
title: Foundation and delivery feasibility
